claims: As of April 2026, Rory McIlroy’s net worth is estimated to be between $255 million and $330 million.
Rory McIlroy is a 2025 Masters champion.
Rory McIlroy has over $100 million in PGA Tour winnings.
Following his 2025 Masters win, Rory McIlroy surpassed $100 million in official PGA Tour prize money.
Rory McIlroy is only the second player in history alongside Tiger Woods to surpass $100 million in official PGA Tour prize money.
Rory McIlroy has a reported 10-year $200 million Nike apparel extension from 2017.
Rory McIlroy has a 10-year deal with TaylorMade.
Rory McIlroy's endorsement partners include Omega, Bose, and UnitedHealth Group.
Forbes ranked Rory McIlroy as the #3 highest-paid golfer in 2025.
Rory McIlroy is a co-founder of TMRW Sports with Tiger Woods.
Rory McIlroy's victory at the 2025 Masters added $4.2 million to his earnings.
According to Golf365, in 2025 McIlroy is considered one of the top 3 richest golfers in the world
